note: Rule IDs are ours. Quotes are NBIM's text. 'from' and 'to' are the first dates we can show a text was public; NBIM publishes no effective dates.
default: Our starting point is to support the board.

rules.heading: Independence of the board
rules.condition: Board has <50% independent members
rules.quote: At a large- or mid-cap company in developed markets, we will not support the election of any non-executive, non-independent director if the board does not have at least 50 percent independent members.

rules.heading: Independence of the board
rules.condition: Board has <1/3 independent members
rules.quote: At a large- or mid-cap, majority-controlled company in developed markets, we will not support the election of any non-executive, non-independent director if the board does not have at least one third independent members.

rules.heading: Independence of the board
rules.condition: Board has fewer than 2 independent members
rules.quote: At a company in emerging markets or at a small-cap company in developed markets, we will not support the election of the chair of the nomination committee if the board does not have at least two independent members.

rules.heading: Independence of the board
rules.condition: Market uses cumulative voting
rules.quote: We will support the election of minority-nominated candidates in markets with cumulative voting.

rules.heading: Independence of main committees
rules.condition: Executive director sits on the remuneration committee
rules.quote: We will not support the election of an executive director who is a member of the remuneration committee.

rules.heading: Independence of main committees
rules.condition: Executive director sits on the audit committee
rules.quote: We will not support the election of an executive director who is a member of the audit committee.

rules.heading: Independence of main committees
rules.condition: Audit committee has <50% independent members
rules.quote: We will not support the election of any non-independent director if the audit committee does not have at least 50 percent independent members.

rules.heading: Separation of chair and CEO
rules.condition: Nominee chair is also the CEO
rules.quote: We will not support the election of a chairperson who is also the CEO of the company.

rules.heading: Separation of chair and CEO
rules.condition: Nominee chair is also the CEO
rules.quote: We may not support the election of a chairperson who is also the CEO of the company.

rules.heading: Separation of chair and CEO
rules.condition: Proposal lets the chair also serve as CEO
rules.quote: We will not support an authorisation for the chairperson to serve as CEO.

rules.heading: Separation of chair and CEO
rules.condition: Proposal separates chair and CEO roles
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to separate the roles of chairperson and CEO.

rules.heading: Time commitment
rules.condition: Director sits on >5 boards, holds >2 board chairs, or otherwise has too many roles
rules.quote: At a company in developed markets, we will not support the election of a director who sits on more than five boards, holds more than two board chairs, or otherwise has too many board or management roles to fulfil effectively his or her responsibilities at the company.

rules.heading: Time commitment
rules.condition: Director attended <75% of board meetings over the last two years
rules.quote: We will not support the election of a director who has attended fewer than 75 percent of board meetings over the last two years.

rules.heading: Industry expertise
rules.condition: No non-executive director has worked in the company's industry
rules.quote: At a company in developed markets, we will not support the re-election of the chair of the nomination committee if there is not at least one non-executive director who has worked in the industry.

rules.heading: Diversity
rules.condition: Board has fewer than 2 members of each gender (general rule)
rules.quote: In general, at a company in developed markets, we will not support the re-election of the chair of the nomination committee if the board does not include at least two members of each gender.

rules.heading: Diversity
rules.condition: Board lacks at least 1 director of each gender
rules.quote: At a company in emerging markets, we will not support the election of the chair of the nomination committee if the board does not include at least one director of each gender.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Proposal staggers/classifies the board
rules.quote: We will not support a proposal to classify (stagger) the board.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Proposal declassifies the board
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to declassify the board.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Election term longer than local-market best practice
rules.quote: We will not support the election of a director with an election term longer than local-market best practice.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Proposal shortens director term (preference: 1 year)
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to shorten the election term of a director, with our preference being one year.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Proposal introduces majority requirement in director elections
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to introduce majority requirements in director elections.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Nominee name not disclosed, or disclosure insufficient to assess suitability
rules.quote: We will not support the election of a director whose name has not been disclosed in the proxy information, or where the disclosure is insufficient to assess his or her suitability.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Support eliminating cumulative voting only if the company allows shareholder input on director elections
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to eliminate cumulative voting only if the company allows for shareholder input on election of directors.

rules.heading: Board nomination and election
rules.condition: Holding requirement <=3 years and ownership requirement <=3%
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to introduce proxy access with holding requirements of up to three years and up to three percent ownership.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Consider whether information raises reasonable doubt about the board's actions
rules.quote: When voting on a proposal to discharge the board of responsibilities, we will consider whether any information raises reasonable doubt about the board’s actions.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Company failed to act on a shareholder request that won majority support the previous year
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of members of the governance or nomination committee, or other directors, if the company has failed to act on material requests from shareholders where such requests received majority support the previous year.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Low support on most recent pay proposal and board failed to address NBIM's concern
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of members of the remuneration committee, or other board members, if the board received low shareholder support for its most recent pay-related proposal and we consider that the board has failed to address our concern.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Board amended governing documents without shareholder approval
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of members of the nomination or governance committee, or other board members, if the board has amended the company’s governing documents without shareholder approval.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Material failure of governance or risk oversight, or breach of fiduciary duty
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of a director, or the entire board, if the company has experienced material failures of governance or risk oversight, or breaches of fiduciary responsibilities.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Director's service on other boards associated with misconduct
rules.quote: We will not support the election of a director whose service on other boards has been associated with misconduct.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Significant concern over previous years' board actions (misstatements, material goodwill write-offs, material legal actions)
rules.quote: We will not support a proposal to discharge a director or the board of liability for their activities if there is significant concern over the board’s actions in previous years, including misstatements, material goodwill write-offs, or material legal actions against the board.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Adverse audit opinion or flagged material weaknesses, not adequately addressed
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of any member of the audit committee, or other board members, if the company’s financial statements received an adverse opinion from its auditor or the auditor flagged material weaknesses, and we consider that the board has failed adequately to address our concern.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Material failure in oversight/management/disclosure of environmental risks
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of a director, or the entire board, if the company has experienced material failures in the oversight, management or disclosure of environmental risks.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Material failure in oversight/management/disclosure of climate risks
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of a director, or the entire board, if the company has experienced material failures in the oversight, management or disclosure of climate risks.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Material failure in oversight/management/disclosure of social risks
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of a director, or the entire board, if the company has experienced material failures in the oversight, management or disclosure of social risks.

rules.heading: Board decisions and conduct
rules.condition: Unsatisfactory financial performance over time, or no faith in a sufficiently profitable strategy
rules.quote: We will not support the re-election of a director, or the entire board, if shareholders have experienced unsatisfactory financial performance over time or we lack faith in the ability to implement a sufficiently profitable strategy.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Vesting or holding period below local-market best practice
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where the vesting or holding period fails to meet local-market best practice.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Accelerated vesting below local-market best practice
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where the accelerated vesting arrangement fails to meet local-market best practice.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Significant concerns over the pay structure
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where we have significant concerns over the structure of the remuneration.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Clear misalignment between pay and long-term value creation
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where there is clear misalignment between remuneration and long-term value creation.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Low support on last pay proposal and concern not adequately addressed
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report if the board received low shareholder support for its most recent pay-related proposal and we consider that the board has failed adequately to address our concern.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Significant concerns over one-off payments (golden hellos/parachutes, severance)
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where we have significant concerns over one-off payments, including golden hellos, golden parachutes and severance payments.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Pension arrangements excessive for the local market
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where the pension arrangements are considered excessive in the local market.

rules.heading: CEO remuneration
rules.condition: Potentially unusually costly outcomes without clear alignment to shareholders
rules.quote: We will not support a remuneration policy or report where outcomes could be unusually costly and the incentive structure does not clearly align with shareholders’ interests.

rules.heading: Voting rights
rules.condition: New/additional common stock class with unequal voting rights
rules.quote: We will not support the creation of new or additional classes of common stock with unequal voting rights.

rules.heading: Voting rights
rules.condition: Abolition on equitable terms
rules.quote: We will support the abolition of a class of common stock with unequal voting rights on equitable terms.

rules.heading: Voting rights
rules.condition: Proposal introduces voting caps
rules.quote: We will not support the introduction of voting caps.

rules.heading: Shareholder meeting
rules.condition: Ownership threshold between 10% and 25%
rules.quote: We will support the right of shareholders to request a general meeting to be called, with a minimum ownership threshold of between 10 and 25 percent.

rules.heading: Shareholder meeting
rules.condition: Requires holders of 50% of outstanding shares
rules.quote: We will support the right of shareholders representing 50 percent of outstanding shares to act by written consent, i.e. act without calling a formal meeting of shareholders.

rules.heading: Shareholder meeting
rules.condition: Proposal de-bundles all agenda items
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to de-bundle all agenda items.

rules.heading: Shareholder meeting
rules.condition: Unless every bundled item is acceptable on its own
rules.quote: We will not support a bundled agenda item unless all included items are acceptable.

rules.heading: Governing documents
rules.condition: Insufficient disclosure
rules.quote: We will not support changes to a company’s governing documents if there is a lack of disclosure.

rules.heading: Governing documents
rules.condition: Change not in shareholders' best interest
rules.quote: We will not support changes to a company’s governing documents that are not in the best interest of shareholders.

rules.heading: Governing documents
rules.condition: Change aims to circumvent a corresponding shareholder proposal
rules.quote: We will not support changes to a company’s governing documents that are aimed at circumventing a corresponding shareholder proposal.

rules.heading: Auditor
rules.condition: Non-audit fees >50% of total fees in two consecutive years
rules.quote: We will not support the appointment of an auditor if the fees paid to the auditor for non-audit services exceed 50 percent of the total fees paid in two consecutive years.

rules.heading: Auditor
rules.condition: Auditor name not disclosed
rules.quote: We will not support the appointment of an auditor whose name is not disclosed.

rules.heading: Auditor
rules.condition: Previous auditor replaced without explanation
rules.quote: We will not support the appointment of an auditor if the previous auditor was replaced without explanation.

rules.heading: Auditor
rules.condition: Serious concerns about the auditor's ability to detect accounting irregularities
rules.quote: We will not support the appointment of an auditor, statutory auditor, or audit committee member if there are serious concerns about the external auditor’s ability to identify accounting irregularities.

rules.heading: Financial statements
rules.condition: Insufficient disclosure or auditor-flagged material weaknesses
rules.quote: We will not support the approval of financial statements if there is insufficient disclosure, or if material weaknesses are flagged by the auditor.

rules.heading: Financial statements
rules.condition: Information insufficient for an informed decision (e.g. 'other business')
rules.quote: We will not support an agenda item if the information disclosed is insufficient to make an informed decision, e.g. the agenda item “other business”.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Imposes a strategy or prescribes detailed methods, unrealistic timeframes or targets
rules.quote: We will not support a shareholder proposal that appears to impose a strategy or prescribe detailed methods, unrealistic timeframes or targets for implementation.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Requests reasonable disclosure on governance, strategy, risk and performance for material sustainability risks
rules.quote: We will support a proposal that requests reasonable disclosure of the company’s governance, strategy, risk exposures and performance data related to material sustainability risks.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Asks board to adopt a policy/framework where management of a material risk looks inadequate
rules.quote: We will support a proposal that requests the board to develop and implement a policy or framework where its management of a material sustainability risk appears inadequate.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Does not address a material sustainability risk or salient issue
rules.quote: We will not support a proposal that does not address a material sustainability risk or salient issue for the company.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Overly prescriptive on strategy/operations, unrealistic timeframes, targets or methods
rules.quote: We will not support a proposal that is overly prescriptive in regard to the company’s strategy and/or operations, that set unrealistic timeframes and targets or methods for implementation.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Company has no significant gaps in managing/reporting the risk (assessed vs NBIM expectation documents)
rules.quote: We will not support a proposal where the company does not appear to have significant gaps in their management or reporting of the relevant sustainability risk. We assess companies against our public expectations on environmental and social issues.

rules.heading: Sustainability
rules.condition: Transition plan misses NBIM core climate expectations and substantive parts of its transition-plan guidance
rules.quote: We will not support proposals on a company’s climate transition plan (‘Say on Climate’) where the plan does not meet our core expectations on climate change and meet substantive portions of our further guidance on transition plans.

rules.heading: Share issuance
rules.condition: Size excessive relative to issued capital
rules.quote: We will not support a general authority to issue shares with pre-emptive rights if the size of the issuance is considered excessive in relation to currently issued capital.

rules.heading: Share issuance
rules.condition: General authority above 20% of issued capital
rules.quote: In developed markets, we will not support a general authority to issue shares without pre-emptive rights above 20 percent of currently issued capital.

rules.heading: Share issuance
rules.condition: General authority above 30% of issued capital
rules.quote: In emerging markets, we will not support a general authority to issue shares without pre-emptive rights above 30 percent of currently issued capital.

rules.heading: Share issuance
rules.condition: Does not create long-term value or does not treat all shareholders fairly
rules.quote: We will not support a share issuance that does not create long-term value for shareholders or does not treat all shareholders fairly.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Insufficient transparency
rules.quote: We will not support mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions where there is insufficient transparency.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Shareholders not treated equitably, or harmful conflicts of interest
rules.quote: We will not support mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions that do not treat all shareholders equitably, or where there are conflicts of interest that could negatively affect shareholders.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Does not create long-term shareholder value
rules.quote: We will not support mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions that do not create long-term value for shareholders.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Requires shareholder approval to adopt/amend anti-takeover measures
rules.quote: We will support a proposal that requires shareholder approval to adopt or amend anti-takeover measures.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Introduction or renewal (poison pills, excessive capital authorisations, classified boards, supermajority requirements, other control-enhancing mechanisms)
rules.quote: We will not support the introduction or renewal of anti-takeover measures, such as shareholder rights plans (poison pills), excessive capital authorisations, classified boards, supermajority vote requirements or other control-enhancing mechanisms.

rules.heading: Mergers, acquisitions and corporate transactions
rules.condition: Proposal abolishes anti-takeover measures
rules.quote: We will support a proposal to abolish anti-takeover measures.

rules.heading: Related-party transactions
rules.condition: Disclosure insufficient to assess the transaction and impact on minority shareholders
rules.quote: We will not support a related-party transaction where the disclosure is insufficient to assess the proposed transaction and its impact on minority shareholders.

rules.heading: Related-party transactions
rules.condition: Not clearly beneficial to all shareholders
rules.quote: We will not support a related-party transaction if the transaction is not clearly beneficial to all shareholders.

templates.1.1: The board should guide company strategy and monitor management performance without conflicts of interest. A majority of shareholder-elected board members in a non-controlled company should be independent of management, dominant shareholders, and related third parties. In a majority-controlled company, at least a third of board members should be independent.
templates.1.2: Board decisions that are particularly vulnerable to conflicts of interest should have additional safeguards. Management should not serve on the audit or remuneration committees. The audit committee should have a majority of independent, shareholder-elected members.
templates.1.3: The board should exercise objective judgement on corporate affairs and be able to make decisions independently of management. The roles of chairperson and CEO should not be held by the same individual. Where a company founder combines both roles, we may support this for a limited period, provided the board has put in place measures to mitigate any conflicts of interest.
templates.2.1: Board members should devote sufficient time to fulfil their responsibilities effectively. The chairperson is responsible for leading all aspects of the board’s work and should devote a significant amount of time to fulfil his or her responsibilities effectively. Board members should contribute to effective discussions and decision-making by attending all meetings.
templates.2.3: Diversity contributes to the overall effectiveness of the board and is a sign of an effective nomination process. The board should ensure that it can bring a broad range of perspectives and approaches to its decision-making process. The board should have an appropriate balance of competencies and backgrounds.
templates.3.1: The company should have a robust nomination and election process to ensure an effective board that is accountable to shareholders. Shareholders should be able to participate in frequent elections of all board members, preferably on an annual basis. The company should establish reasonable procedures for shareholders to include proposals in the meeting material distributed by the company, including proposing board candidates.
templates.3.2: Shareholders should have the right to seek changes to the board when it does not act in their best interest. We will consider whether the board has failed to act on material requests from shareholders, sought to circumvent shareholder proposals or implemented governance changes limiting shareholders’ rights without their approval. When voting on a proposal to discharge the board of responsibilities, we will consider whether any information raises reasonable doubt about the board’s actions. We will also take into considerations unsatisfactory financial and strategic performance, mismanaged risk-taking, unacceptable treatment of stakeholders or undesired environmental or social outcomes from company operations.
templates.3.3: The board is responsible for attracting the right CEO and setting appropriate remuneration. A substantial proportion of annual remuneration should be provided as shares that are locked in for five to ten years, regardless of resignation or retirement. The board should provide transparency on total remuneration to avoid unacceptable outcomes. The board should ensure that all benefits have a clear business rationale. Pensionable income should constitute a minor part of total remuneration.
templates.4.2: Shareholders should in certain circumstances have the opportunity to raise issues of material importance without having to wait for management to schedule a meeting. All proposals subject to shareholder approval should be presented as individual items, and the vote tally should be published.
templates.4.3: The right to vote on fundamental changes affecting the company is a basic right of shareholders. This includes the right to approve changes to the company’s governing documents.
templates.5.1: The external auditor should act in an independent manner. We will consider the auditor’s independence and any concerns about the accounts or audit procedures. Excessive non-audit-related fees represent a potential conflict of interest and should be avoided.
templates.5.2: We will not support an agenda item if the information disclosed is insufficient to make an informed decision.
templates.5.3: The board should account for material sustainability risks facing the company, and the broader environmental and social consequences of its operations and products. Sustainability disclosures should be aligned with applicable global reporting standards and frameworks to support investors in their analysis of risks and opportunities. Where a company’s disclosure does not meet our needs as a financial investor, we will consider supporting a well-founded shareholder proposal calling for reasonable disclosure. We will not support a shareholder proposal that appears to impose a strategy or prescribe detailed methods, unrealistic timeframes or targets for implementation.
templates.6.1: Existing shareholders should have the right to approve share issuances in order to prevent the dilution of ownership without their prior consent. Existing shareholders should have the right to participate pro rata to maintain their voting share and benefit from any discount offered. The approval for a general authority should be reasonably close in time to the intended capital allocation to allow for an informed voting decision.
templates.6.2: Anti-takeover measures are generally not in the interest of shareholders, and the introduction of such measures should, at a minimum, be subject to shareholder approval. We define anti-takeover measures to include any mechanism likely to deter or frustrate takeovers.
templates.6.3: Transactions between related parties should be avoided unless they are demonstrably beneficial to all shareholders. The board should disclose the name and affiliation of each party involved, value and cost of the transaction, and business rationale.
templates.2.2: The board should have a thorough understanding of the industry in which the company operates. The board should have sufficient industry expertise to monitor management’s implementation of company strategy. Shareholders should be able to understand which independent directors bring relevant industry expertise to the board.
templates.4.1: All shareholders should have the right to vote on fundamental corporate decisions, and voting rights should be proportionate to cash flow rights. One share should give one vote. Any unequal voting rights should be time-limited and aligned with cash flow rights over time.
